The plate looks like a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, though the photo is taken at an angle. The apple is about 7 cm across, so it is medium-small and weighs roughly 150 g, which is about 78 kcal.

There are 7 fries, each about 7-8 cm long and thin. They look like thin, dry, possibly over-fried fries, so I'd put them at about 3-4 g each, or roughly 25 g total. At about 3 kcal per gram, that is about 75 kcal.

That gives a total of about 175 g of food and about 150 kcal.
